name: backlink-check
title_zh: 不只看外链数量，连锚文本分布都摊开给你看的反链体检
tagline_zh: 查域名反链，别只数总数。它把引荐域、权重、锚文本、新增/丢失链接全拆开，还能和竞品并排比，一眼看出谁在偷偷挖你墙角。
tagline_en: Stop counting links. See referring domains, authority, anchors, and new/lost links at a glance, plus a.
desc_en: Backlink profile for any domain — referring domains, authority, anchors, new/lost links, and a side-by-side vs a competitor. Use when asked "check my backlinks", "backlink profile of X", "who links to them", or "link gap vs competitor".
why_zh: 多数工具只给个总分，它却把链接质量拆成可行动的维度，并直接给出与竞品的差距清单，省掉你手动比对三四个报。
why_en: Most tools give a vanity score. This one breaks link quality into actionable dimensions and hands you a direct gap list against.
limit_zh: 只认公开可查的域名级数据，不覆盖具体页面URL级反链；需要目标域名可正常访问，否则直接报错；不提供历史趋势曲线。
limit_en: Domain-level public data only, no per-URL links; target domain must resolve or it errors; snapshot only, no historical trend curves.
title_en: Backlink audit that lays out anchor texts, not just a.
